spanish: Y puso sobre él el pectoral, y dio al pectoral las luces y las perfecciones.
grammarChanges: joshen -> pectoral (H2833 is a common noun; translated instead of transliterated)
los urim -> las luces (H224 is a common noun; translated instead of transliterated, article changed to feminine to agree with luces)
los tumim -> las perfecciones (H8550 is a common noun; translated instead of transliterated, article changed to feminine to agree with perfecciones)
readerNote: Chose luces and perfecciones, both feminine in Spanish, for the masculine-plural Hebrew nouns urim/tumim, so los became las.
